About your guide

Every consultation begins with listening. I read your birth chart, your palm or the layout of your space, then explain what I see in clear, practical terms.

My work follows the Vedic tradition, with regular puja, havan and sadhana as its foundation. Whether you face a decision about career or marriage, or want guidance for a new home, you will receive honest and respectful direction.

Common questions

How does an online session work?

After you book, I confirm the time and send a call link or phone number. Sessions run by phone or video, and no special equipment is needed.

What details do I need for a birth chart reading?

Your date, exact time and place of birth. If you are unsure of the time, mention it in the form and we will work with what you have.

How do I pay?

Payment is made online by UPI before the session. A payment link or QR code is sent with your confirmation.

Can I get a Vastu review without a visit?

Yes. Send a floor plan and a few photos, and mention the direction each room faces. An in-person visit is also possible.
